metadata.description: AI-assisted project governance scaffold with mandatory quality gates

plugins.name: forge-kit-adapt
plugins.description: Reads your project, recommends the forge-kit components that fit it, and installs the ones you approve, adapted to it.

plugins.name: forge-kit-governance
plugins.description: A ticket readiness gate, governed overnight work, session handoffs, and opt-in hooks that hold sessions to your rules.

plugins.name: forge-kit-roadmap
plugins.description: Rolling wave planning: docs/roadmap.md lists the phases, forge milestones hold their tickets, and a guard checks both.

plugins.name: forge-kit-review
plugins.description: Code, architecture and standards reviewers, plus /full-review, a multi-lens audit that fixes or tickets its findings.

plugins.name: forge-kit-security
plugins.description: Security and API audits, privacy regime duties, a leak guard for a repo going public, and an opt-in scan of forge posts.

plugins.name: forge-kit-testing
plugins.description: mutation-sweep finds covered lines whose tests cannot fail, the defect class that line coverage cannot see.

plugins.name: forge-kit-devops
plugins.description: Release, CI health, dependency and dead-code audits, usage reports, and the GitHub or Forgejo adapter other groups use.
